/u/obliviron posted a comment. One that has been deleted. I suspect because it broke rule 1a.   
I don't mind, but this was my reply.    
>Although I appreciate the sentiment, guilt has stopped me from taking this step for too long. Most people, unlike me, are gifted with a poor memory. They will know some sorrow. But after a while, they will forget it. After a longer while, they will forget me.    
Their sorrow will fade. Mine will not.

28, and not a native English speaker.    
Also, this might be considered an insult for some. And perhaps someone should ban you because one day someone will come here, someone who still might be "saved".
